about: T4 step 2 (road map 26 Nov 2026): the round trip step 10 -> CAESAR II edits -> transfer -> step 10 -> transfer, run by tests/uxml-v2-step10-roundtrip.test.mjs. 'source' is the XML step 10 first runs on: BM2's source XML is not in the 3D_Converters checkout, so step 10 first runs on this folder's Enriched XML (it gives step10.cii byte for byte). The edits are made by prototypes/u2d-cii-source/tests/roundtrip_t4.py on step 10's first CII.

edits.values: wall thickness (element from end) and insulation (to end) at every point today's transfer refuses, one value per node id
